content.comment_body: Hello, I am programming [product_name] modules for our production. When I attempt to update the program over Ethernet, some [product_name] modules aren't detected by [product_name] engineering software, and I need to use an SD Card for those devices. Why can't I always use Ethernet to update certain modules? Also, when I upload a program using the SD Card, is it still possible to access that module via a web browser?

I'm unable to provide a specific answer because your question lacks details. I haven't encountered this issue before. You haven't shared any information about IP addresses or the software version you're using. If the SD Card isn't present in the [product_name] module, the web server functionality may not work correctly.
Ensure you have selected the correct hardware version when using [product_name] engineering software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report inconsistent recognition of [product_name] modules when updating via Ethernet using [product_name] engineering software, leading them to depend on SD Card updates instead of network-based solutions. There is also uncertainty about whether web browser access remains available after uploading programs through SD Card, indicating a lack of clear documentation about product features and limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all [product_name] modules to be reliably recognized over Ethernet for software updates. They also seek clarification on whether web browser access is retained after uploading programs via SD Card.
